purpose: Append-only history of every re-pin of an MS paid-packet proof, and of every retirement of one generation in favour of another. A proof that is edited to go green proves nothing; a proof that is re-derived and whose move is recorded here remains evidence. Entries are never rewritten or removed.
rule: A pinned input hash is never updated to make a check pass. When a pinned file's bytes move, the move is diagnosed first: if it was not an intentional, reviewed change, the bytes are restored or the work is held and reported. If it was intentional, the proof is REGENERATED by its own generator over the current bytes, the prior pin is preserved here, the behavioural delta is stated, and the regenerated proof must still be mutation-sensitive. A proof generation is never retired to escape its own pins: a retirement is recorded only when a new owner decision supersedes the packet the proof measured, it must enumerate every pin left unreconciled at retirement, and the retired proof file is kept unchanged.

parityAndSafetyEvidence.note: The approved packet bytes are unchanged and the current renderer still reproduces them exactly, so the collection rework did not alter what this route delivers.

mutationSensitivityPreserved.how: Nine controls per fixture, re-derived at regeneration time rather than copied: each key of the final-verification bound inputs is perturbed in turn and the resulting digest must differ. A regenerated proof that had stopped binding a field would fail its own generator before it could be written.
mutationSensitivityPreserved.rasterAndApprovalChecks: The generator also re-reads every raster page, the legal participant-delivery review and the packet specification, and refuses if any of them no longer hashes to what the approval records.
